name: PHMN
subtitle: Your WHOOP strap, reshaped around your own routine.
description:
An AltStore / SideStore source for PHMN, a personal fork of NOOP. Everything is computed and stored on your iPhone: no account, no server, no telemetry.

PHMN is not affiliated with WHOOP, Inc. Every figure is an estimate, not medical advice.

apps.name: PHMN
apps.subtitle: Charge, Effort and Rest from your own WHOOP strap, on your phone.
apps.localizedDescription:
PHMN reads a WHOOP 4.0 / 5.0 / MG strap you own directly over Bluetooth and keeps every number on your iPhone. A Today screen you can read in seconds, a gym of its own, Nutrition and a Lab Book, and Anya, a coach that reads your day (bring your own provider, or use Apple Intelligence on the device).

A fork of NOOP, built for one person's routine. Source: https://github.com/aansun/PHMNoop

versions.localizedDescription: Charge, Effort and Rest follow the day you pick, Effort shows what builds it, the resting heart rate is the nightly average everywhere, a monitor-style heart-rate card, a simpler Compare and a glass strap-sync card.
The Flow look, capsule charts for Charge and Effort, a Banner design for the workout Live Activity, a gym session you can change as you go, and gym sessions on Strava with their sets.
Nutrition rebuilt with a daily budget and a diary you can fill by telling Anya; a Lab Book in the Nuna style that Anya can fill from a report; exercise videos.
Gym summary redesigned, tappable explanations on Today, a Trends header that pages through your history, and fixes for workouts that lost their targets.
A new Effort target for an activity, a heart rate that beats in its zone colour, treadmill on Strava, and a clearer night.
Workout detail, pinned workouts, Anya sheet on the card's line.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: PHMN connects directly to your WHOOP strap over Bluetooth to read heart rate, R-R intervals, battery, and sensor data locally on your iPhone. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PHMN records your route during an outdoor workout to show distance, pace, and a map, and keeps recording while the screen is off. The route stays on your device. Only if you turn on Weather and air, your place rounded to about a kilometre is sent to OpenWeather and IQAir to get the weather and air quality. Nothing else leaves it.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: NOOP reads your heart rate from the Watch sensor to show a live readout on your wrist. It stays on your device.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: NOOP records a basic workout session on your Watch for a higher-fidelity heart rate. The session stays on your device.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: PHMN reads your iPhone's step count for a walking or running workout to show steps in the activity summary. It stays on your device. Nothing leaves it.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: PHMN uses the camera to photograph a meal so Anya can estimate its calories. The photo is used only for that, and only goes to the Anya provider you chose when you ask her to work it out.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: PHMN uses the microphone to let you ask the coach a question by voice. The audio is transcribed on-device and never leaves your iPhone.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: PHMN transcribes your question on-device so you can ask the coach out loud instead of typing. Audio never leaves your iPhone.
